_comment: Coordinates are in pixels, relative to the DESKEWED, RESIZED reference image at reference_width x reference_height. Every scanned sheet is resized to this size before boxes are cropped, so coordinates stay valid regardless of the scanner's native resolution. box = [x, y, width, height], measured from the top-left corner.

alignment_markers._comment: Four solid black squares printed in the corners of the answer sheet, used to detect and correct rotation/skew before cropping boxes. Draw these on your real template as filled squares roughly 25x25 px at reference resolution. Inset 100px (~17mm) from the page edge — a tighter margin risks a marker rotating off-frame if a scanned/photographed sheet is skewed by more than a couple of degrees.
